framework.primary_law: Artificial Intelligence Bill, 2026 (published; not enacted). Kenya National AI Strategy 2025–2030; Data Protection Act 2019
framework.enforcing_body: Proposed Office of the AI Commissioner; Office of the Data Protection Commissioner
framework.geographic_scope: Proposed to cover AI systems used in Kenya.

source_documents.title: AI Regulation in Africa 2026: Country-by-Country Tracker

research.summary: Kenya's Artificial Intelligence Bill, 2026 (reported 17 June 2026) would create a risk-based regime with pre-deployment risk and human rights impact assessments for high-risk systems, human oversight, explainability, labelling of AI-generated likeness, workforce impact assessments, and an independent AI Commissioner. It is not law. Scores reflect protections in force, chiefly the Data Protection Act 2019.

key_provisions.title: AI Commissioner (proposed)
key_provisions.description: Independent office also overseeing Data Protection Act implementation.

key_provisions.title: Data Protection Act 2019
key_provisions.description: Rights over personal data including contesting automated decisions.

cross_jurisdiction_tensions.tension: The bill borrows EU risk concepts but Kenya's enforcement capacity is untested.

safety_risk_management.rationale: No binding AI risk framework in force.

human_oversight.rationale: Right to human intervention under data law.

accountability.rationale: Data Commissioner enforces data law only.

gaps_and_weaknesses: The AI Bill is not enacted.
Penalties not described in the source.
research.monitor_notes: Confirm the bill's parliamentary stage and whether the Senate or National Assembly version is current. Scores are provisional AI-drafted judgements against the AIETHOS rubric and reflect protections currently in force.

citizen.one_line: Kenya has published a rights-focused AI bill but it is not yet law; data protection law is the main safeguard.
citizen.what_changed: In 2026 Kenya proposed a law requiring impact checks on risky AI and an AI Commissioner. It has not passed yet.
citizen.who_is_protected: People in Kenya through the Data Protection Act.
who_is_not_protected: People harmed by AI outside data protection

your_rights.what_it_means: The Data Protection Act gives a right to human intervention and to contest automated decisions.
your_rights.how_to_invoke: Write to the data controller; complain to the Data Protection Commissioner.

citizen.plain_language_summary: Kenya's AI bill would protect rights strongly if passed; for now data protection law applies.

jargon_buster.AI Commissioner: A proposed independent official overseeing AI.
jargon_buster.High-risk system: AI in sensitive areas such as health, jobs or public services.
